messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Hacktoberfest + Stan
parts:
Hi all,

If anyone on this list wanted to contribute to Stan as part of Hacktoberfest, I'm willing to help you get set up. For now, an open email on the users list will suffice. If it gets into the nitty gritty of development, we can move it off the users list and onto the dev list.

Hacktoberfest is GitHub and Digital Ocean supporting open source by giving away T-shirts to contributors with 4 pull requests to open source projects between Oct 1 and Oct 31.
https://github.com/blog/2260-hacktoberfest-is-back
https://hacktoberfest.digitalocean.com/

We have lots of Stan repositories you can help with. See:
https://github.com/stan-dev


Daniel
